draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Ponda! Sitting right at the geographic heart of Goa, ringed by green villages and grand temples, it's what the Goa government calls the cultural city of Goa.
draft.hungryLine: Don't miss the Goan Hindu style of cooking in this area, especially the fish preparations, which are typical of Ponda and quite unique.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Safa Mosque, built in 1560 by Ibrahim Adil Shah, is about an 18 min walk, and the big temples like Mangueshi at Priol and Shanta Durga at Kavlem are a short drive out.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Book a spice farm visit, like Pascoal Spice Village 8 km from town, where you get a tour of the estate and a meal.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Ponda was part of North Goa district until January 2015, when it was shifted to South Goa.

spots.name: Safa Mosque
spots.detail: 18 min walk · A 16th century mosque with a garden and fountains, protected by the ASI

spots.name: Pascoal Spice Village
spots.detail: 8 km from Ponda town · A real spice farm with a tour and food

spots.name: Butterfly Conservatory Of Goa
spots.detail: Short drive, at Priol · Over 100 species of free-flying butterflies

legends.title: The Durga of peace
legends.body: Shantadurga is a much loved deity here, worshipped in a unique form as a Durga of peace, as her name suggests. Her temple complex is at Kavlem in Ponda taluka.

tips.title: Come in December for music.
tips.body: The Samrat Club's annual Sangeet Sammelan, in memory of Master Dinanath Mangueshkar, is held at the Shantadurga Temple in Kavlem, usually around December.

tips.title: Dress modestly at the temples.
tips.body: Ponda is the heartland of Goa's Hindu festivities, so cover up when you visit the temples.

story.title: Safa Masjid
story.body: Ibrahim Adil Shah, the Bijapuri ruler, built the Safa Masjid on the outskirts of Ponda. It has a rectangular prayer hall under a terracotta tile roof.

story.title: The siege of Ponda
story.body: Shivaji led the Marathas against the Bijapur Sultanate for the strategic fort of Ponda in 1666. A second siege followed in 1675.

story.title: A new district
story.body: In January 2015 Ponda moved from North Goa district to South Goa.

story.title: Temples and spices
story.body: Ponda is the cultural capital for Indian-style music in Goa, and spice farm tours now draw visitors too.
